meta_description: Speak, and your words appear in any Windows app. Speech recognition runs on your PC: free, private, no account.
hero_sub: Private dictation for every Windows app. Press one key, talk, and your words land wherever your cursor is. Recognized on your PC, never in the cloud.
stage_label: Animation: SuperDictate listens in four languages and pastes each sentence into a document.
how_title: One key. That's the whole interface.
how_sub: No window to open, no text to copy over. SuperDictate waits quietly in the tray until you need it.
step1_text: Anywhere: a browser, a chat, a document or your code editor.
step2_text: Talk naturally. A small capsule at the top of the screen shows it's listening.
step3_text: Your words are recognized on your PC and pasted where your cursor is.
apps_sub: SuperDictate types into the app you're already using, so there's nothing new to learn.
apps_label: Animation: the same dictation lands in a chat, an email, a code editor and a search box.
sample_chat: On my way, be there in ten minutes.
sample_mail: Hi Anna, the contract is attached. Let me know if anything needs changing.
sample_code: // Cache the parsed settings so the window opens faster
sample_search: quiet cafés with good wifi nearby
privacy_title: Your voice never leaves your PC.
privacy_sub: Recognition runs on your own computer with faster-whisper. No account, no ads, no analytics, no telemetry.
privacy_p1: Speech is recognized on your PC, and the recording is deleted right after.
privacy_p2: It goes online only when you click: to download the engine, a model or an update.
privacy_p3: Every download is checked against a pinned checksum before it's used.
privacy_p4: Logs never contain what you said.
privacy_note: Optional Cloud AI cleanup sends finished text, never audio, to a service you choose. It's off by default.
diag_label: Diagram: your voice goes to your PC and comes back as text; nothing is sent to speech servers.
mic_title: Prefer clicking? There's a button for that.
mic_sub: A round microphone button floats above your apps. Click to start, click to finish, drag it wherever it's comfortable. It never takes focus from what you're typing in.
mic_label: Animation: the floating microphone button is dragged into place, clicked, and the text appears.
mic_sample: Sounds good, let's ship it on Monday.
cleanup_sub: Optional AI cleanup removes filler words, stutters and spoken punctuation, and tidies capitalization.
cleanup_before_html: <s>Um,</s> so the <s>the</s> demo is on Friday <s>comma</s> right after lunch.
cleanup_after: So the demo is on Friday, right after lunch.
lang_sub: English, Russian, German and Polish, detected automatically. Turn off the ones you don't speak and detection gets even sharper.
setup_sub: The installer needs no administrator rights. On first start, SuperDictate downloads its own speech engine and the model you pick, with progress you can see and cancel.
setup_label: Animation: the SuperDictate settings window installs the speech runtime and downloads a model, then turns Ready.
folder_title: Everything in one folder you choose.
folder_text: The program, speech engine, models, settings and logs live together, on the drive with the most room rather than C:. Updates replace the program and nothing else.
models_sub: From tiny and quick to large and precise. Switch any time.
gpu_text: Several times faster recognition on NVIDIA graphics cards. Optional, about 1.3 GB.
free_sub: SuperDictate is free for everyone, including at work. The full source is on GitHub under MIT with the Commons Clause: use it, change it, share it, just don't sell it.
final_sub: Download SuperDictate, press Right Alt and talk.
final_req: Windows 10 (version 2004 or later) or Windows 11, 64-bit · About 2 GB of disk space
final_note: The installer isn't code-signed yet, so Windows may say it protected your PC: choose More info, then Run anyway. You can verify the file with SHA256SUMS.txt on the release page.
